policy: Every requirement is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the ICP page named in source_roles. Figures are quoted, never restated.
structure_note: Blue Residence has three eligibility categories — environmental and sustainability influencers, scientists and researchers, and investors and entrepreneurs. Labels scope every rule to its category. Two different AED 1 million figures appear on this page for different things (financial support given by an influencer; annual revenues achieved by an investor's project) and a flattened list would make them look like one requirement.
freshness_note: The page publishes a dateline of 2026-08-20.
not_extracted: Fees. The page names no amounts.
The Golden-to-Blue conversion route. The page states it is possible 'upon meeting the eligibility requirements' without stating a separate procedure, so nothing is recorded as a requirement.

requirements.label: Granted for exceptional environmental contribution
requirements.description: Blue Residence is scoped by the nature of the applicant's contribution rather than by employment or investment alone, and the authority counts contributions made outside the UAE.
requirements.source_excerpt: this residence is granted to individuals who make exceptional contributions to environmental protection and sustainability, whether within the uae or internationally.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: This residence is granted to individuals who make exceptional contributions to environmental protection and sustainability, whether within the UAE or internationally.

requirements.label: Ten years, renewable, no sponsor
requirements.description: Twice the Green Residence term, and like it requires no sponsoring employer.
requirements.source_excerpt: residence duration: 10 years, renewable, without the need for a sponsor within the uae.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Residence duration: 10 years, renewable, without the need for a sponsor within the UAE.

requirements.label: Influencers: proof of membership in environmental initiatives
requirements.source_excerpt: provide proof of membership and participation in environmental initiatives.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Provide proof of membership and participation in environmental initiatives.

requirements.label: Influencers: recommendation letters and certificates of recognition
requirements.description: Alongside accreditation and award evidence the page also lists.
requirements.source_excerpt: submit recommendation letters and certificates of recognition.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Submit recommendation letters and certificates of recognition.

requirements.label: Influencers: financial support of at least AED 1 million
requirements.description: Support GIVEN by the applicant. Not to be confused with the AED 1 million annual REVENUE figure the page sets for investors — same number, different party, different meaning.
requirements.source_excerpt: provide proof of financial support (of no less than aed 1 million).
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Provide proof of financial support (of no less than AED 1 million).

requirements.label: Scientists: nomination from the UAE Council of Scientists
requirements.description: A nomination the applicant cannot self-issue.
requirements.source_excerpt: obtain a nomination from the uae council of scientists.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Obtain a nomination from the UAE Council of Scientists.

requirements.label: Scientists: master's or PhD in environmental or energy fields
requirements.description: The field is constrained, not only the level.
requirements.source_excerpt: hold a master's degree or phd in environmental or energy-related fields.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Hold a master's degree or PhD in environmental or energy-related fields.

requirements.label: Scientists: qualifications from internationally ranked universities
requirements.description: An additional constraint on the same qualification.
requirements.source_excerpt: the qualifications must be from internationally ranked universities.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The qualifications must be from internationally ranked universities.

requirements.label: Scientists: recognised scientific indicators (FWCI or h-index)
requirements.description: The authority names the specific metrics it will accept.
requirements.source_excerpt: achieve recognised scientific indicators such as fwci or h-index.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Achieve recognised scientific indicators such as FWCI or h-index.

requirements.label: Scientists: Scopus reports or evidence of research achievements
requirements.description: Documentary proof of the indicators above.
requirements.source_excerpt: submit scopus reports or evidence of research achievements.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Submit Scopus reports or evidence of research achievements.

requirements.label: Investors: invest in high-value environmental projects
requirements.description: The sector is constrained, unlike the Golden Residency's investor route.

requirements.label: Investors: capital of at least AED 2 million
requirements.description: The same headline figure as the Golden Residency investor route, for a differently scoped project.
requirements.source_excerpt: capital of no less than aed 2 million.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Capital of no less than AED 2 million.

requirements.label: Investors: the capital must be fully owned
requirements.description: Not financed — the authority states full ownership.
requirements.source_excerpt: the capital must be fully owned.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The capital must be fully owned.

requirements.label: Investors: register the project as an SME
requirements.description: Under the small and medium-sized enterprises category.
requirements.source_excerpt: register the project under the small and medium-sized enterprises (smes) category.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Register the project under the small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) category.

requirements.label: Investors: annual revenues of at least AED 1 million
requirements.description: Revenue ACHIEVED by the project. The influencer category's AED 1 million is financial support given, which is a different obligation on a different applicant.
requirements.source_excerpt: achieve annual revenues of no less than aed 1 million.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Achieve annual revenues of no less than AED 1 million.
